Past incident (verified match):
API: Razorpay
Error: Webhook signature verification failed: invalid signature
Root cause: A global JSON body-parser middleware re-serialized the request body before it reached the webhook handler, so the bytes we HMAC-ed were not the exact bytes Razorpay signed.
Fix: Verify `X-Razorpay-Signature` as HMAC-SHA256 of the raw, untouched request body using RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET - read the body before any JSON parsing middleware runs (e.g. exclude the webhook route or capture request.body() first).
Resolved by: priya on 2026-03-14

history.reply:
[offline mode: TypeError - set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for full reasoning.]
Team memory says:
Past incident (verified match):
API: Twilio
Error: HTTP 429: Too Many Requests on outbound SMS, no Retry-After header
Root cause: Twilio's per-number rate limit (1 msg/sec on trial/local numbers) isn't documented in the main API reference - it only appears in the messaging-limits guide - and Twilio does not return a `Retry-After` header, so naive backoff assumed no limit existed.
Fix: Implement a fixed queue that sends at most 1 message/sec per originating number, with exponential backoff on any 429 regardless of headers.
Resolved by: priya on 2026-01-20
